description: This file defines the 'Document' class in the MigraDoc library, representing a document with properties, methods for cloning, serialization, and managing sections, styles, and embedded files.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Represents a MigraDoc document with properties, methods for cloning, serialization, and managing document content such as sections, styles, and embedded files.

classes.name: Document.DocumentValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for the Document class.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Document object.

methods.name: AddSection
methods.description: Adds a new section to the document.

methods.name: AddStyle
methods.description: Adds a new style to the document styles.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a section or style to the document.

methods.name: AddEmbeddedFile
methods.description: Embeds a file into the document.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the document into DDL format.

methods.name: AcceptVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to traverse the document and its children.
